utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you want me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you start by checking which tools we already have and what still needs to be borrowed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll check our tools first and make a list of what we still need to borrow.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’m checking the repair drive details first. What tools and parts do you have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got a basic screwdriver set, pliers, duct tape, and a small hammer. If you tell me the list, I can check for anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have for the repair drive and note what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great—thanks. I might’ve missed a few things, so just let me know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll make a quick list of what’s on hand and what’s missing, then I’ll let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m happy to help if you need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you, Rey — I just need to sort out the timing and what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, just let me know when you’ve got it lined up. I can help gather whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are you still up for the repair drive? I can bring tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’m still in — thanks, Mina. I’ll probably need the second-hand rundown when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure thing — I’ll bring the tools and give you the rundown when we get there. What time should we head over?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice turnout already — folks are bringing tools and snacks. I can swing by later and see if they still need any extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess — they could probably use an extra pair of hands later. If you want, I can lend you my toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s mighty kind of you, Gus — I’d appreciate that toolbox. I’ll swing by later and help wherever they need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive — come by if you can, it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for the heads-up, Quinn — I’ll try to swing by and see where you’re setting up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll save you a spot near the setup and point you to the tables when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You can? Just to confirm, you’re really up for it—what can you handle first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can start by sorting donations or helping carry supplies, whichever you need first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m getting the repair drive organized and I can keep the list tidy if you send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—send me what you need, and I’ll keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—just send the item, the address, and a quick note on what needs fixing, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks about the plan. We can keep it simple and make sure everyone knows when and where.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. Let’s keep the plan clear and steady so everyone knows what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan so it stays clear, and I’ll make sure folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to check the sign-up sheet, but I forgot. I can still help out if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, Oren. If you have a moment, could you check the sign-up sheet and let me know what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll go check it now and come back with what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and maybe swing by with any tools you’ve got? That’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring what tools I have by. Just let me know what time to stop over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive is moving along nicely — I’ve already been telling folks to swing by and help out. If you’re free, Dane, I’d love to have you join us.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m in — sorry I’m always late to these things. I’ll swing by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries at all — I’m just glad you’re coming. See you there, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive — I can help out if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I’d appreciate it—let’s keep it simple and set a clear time to sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pick-up and drop-off times for the repair drive. What part of the schedule needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — the biggest gap is the mid-afternoon window. If you can help cover school pick-up and drop-off then, that would really keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I can cover the mid-afternoon school pick-up and drop-off window.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help link folks up for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can send you the list of items and who’s available, then you can help match people up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send me the list and I’ll start matching folks up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few tools by for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—could you bring a tape measure, a drill, and maybe some extension cords? I’m a little worried we’ll run short on power and workspace.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a tape measure, a drill, and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the repair drive location for you—just tell me where it’s set up, and I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know the location as soon as it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — just send me the spot when you know it, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — let me just double-check the time and location before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time and where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we need tools, tape, and a few spare screws. Could you check what you’ve got and bring anything useful?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check my toolbox and bring whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I might’ve missed the latest—what’s the repair drive up to now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only know the scraps I’ve heard too, honestly. Maybe we should check with someone who’s been closer to it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the repair drive is definitely happening, right? Just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for sure — folks are still pulling things together, but the repair drive is on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks — I just wanted to confirm it’s really on the calendar. If anything changes, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I’ve been hearing a bit about the repair drive while I was out running errands. How’s it going on your end?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going alright, I think. I’ve just been keeping to the quieter tasks for now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That makes sense — quiet tasks still help a lot. Let me know if you want an extra pair of hands when you’re ready for more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to ask if there’s anything I can bring by. I’m a bit forgetful, but I’d still like to help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — just bring any spare tools or sturdy boxes if you’ve got them. I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll look around for some spare tools and a couple sturdy boxes. Just give me a shout if you think of anything else!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You really can help with it? Which part are you taking on first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll start by sorting the donation list and checking what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally — I’m still confirming the exact timing, but I’ll share it as soon as I have it. The drop-off spot is the community center parking lot, and I’ll send the full details right after I lock them in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — just send me the timing and full drop-off details when they’re set so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Mara—just tell me which houses need the most help first, and I’ll organize the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — let’s start with the Wilsons’ place and the corner house on Maple; both need the most help. I’ll walk the block and flag any others.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll put the Wilsons and the Maple corner house at the top, and we can slot in the rest as you flag them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — yes, I think so! Let me check my notes and I’ll get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Just let me know once you check, so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. Let me know if you want me to mention the repair drive to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — please do mention the repair drive to folks if it comes up. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll mention it if I hear anyone talking about repairs. Just keep me posted if there’s anything specific you want me to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’ll need to keep it low-key. Just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — just keep an eye out for folks who can lend tools or a little time, and I’ll pass along the rest quietly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — I’ll ask around discreetly and point anyone helpful your way. I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan before I commit, Nell. If you know the date and what they’re fixing, let me know and I’ll see if I can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the date or the full list yet—I’m mostly hearing second-hand. If I learn more, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great to hear, Bo — we’ve got a few loose rails and a leaky faucet to tackle. If you can bring a wrench, I’ll grab the tape and screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a wrench. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — could you check what needs fixing first and who’s bringing tools? I’ll swing by a bit late, but I can still help once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll check what needs fixing first and who’s bringing tools, then let you know. Thanks for the heads-up about being late.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and make a list of anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Cleo — if you can, note where each item is stored too so I can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll make sure to include each item’s storage spot too, and I’ll bring you the list once I’ve checked everything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m a bit scattered today. I’ll grab the repair drive details and send them over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — send them when you can and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m in, and I’ll spread the word to the neighbors right away. Let me know the time and place, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have it. Really appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — happy to help. Just send it over when you have it, and I’ll get the word out.
